thread:
margot: Thanks for joining today — quick post-AH follow-up thread to capture the outstanding Q&A items and owners. Keeping this short: three asks (release dates, docs, and customer outreach). Links at the end. :sparkles:
eli: quick ask — what was the concrete ETA for the client libs updates we mentioned?
margot: target: 2026-07-20 for JS/Python minor releases with deprecation banners. Canaries for SDK tests start 2026-07-10.
nora: docs + migration guide owner? we need a one-pager + checklist for AMs to use.
margot: owner: nora + docs team. due: 2026-07-15. Please include a quick CLI snippet and upgrade table.
chris: ops note — we flagged three customers in the AH who need high-touch migration help. I'll coordinate with AMs; want the outreach cadence.
nora: outreach cadence proposal: 1) beta invite email 2026-06-25, 2) 1:1 migration calls week of 2026-07-05, 3) follow-up report by 2026-07-20. Agree?
chris: yes, I'll sync with AMs and add calendar invites.
build-bot: CI job created: "sdk-canary-tests" scheduled for 2026-07-10. Notifying #devex.
leah: product note — confirm rollback policy if migration causes regressions. We promised automatic fallback to legacy-compatible variants for 72 hours post-shift, right?
margot: correct. Rollout policy: canary (internal) -> external 10% -> full shift with 72h automated fallback window. Ops/infra keep emergency rollback playbook.
eli: action recap (one line each): 1) SDK releases + canary tests (eli) - 2026-07-20; 2) migration one-pager + CLI snippet (nora + docs) - 2026-07-15; 3) customer outreach + invites (chris + AMs) - invites by 2026-06-25; 4) rollback/runbook confirm (ops) - 2026-06-30.
margot: canonical RFC: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/ah-postfollow-2026, slides: https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-jul-2026#followups. I'll open follow-up threads in #devex and #eng-runtime for details. Ping me to be added to owners. Thanks! :tada:
